Name: (CP) Sequential Dateables Heart Events (SDHE)
Author: Enri0425
Description:
This mod edits each vanilla bachelor/bachelorette's heart events so that they're [b]forced to happen in order[/b].
For example, with this mod you won't be able to see Shane's 6th heart event before seeing his 2nd and 4th one.

If you're like me, who is bothered by seeing Alex's 4th heart event before his 2nd one since it can only happen in Summer, this mod is for you!
And speaking of Alex, if you also don't like how his 2nd and 8th heart event can only occur during Summer, I added an option through Generic Mod Config Tool to make them happen in other seasons as well, you just need to pick the "[b]ON (Accessible Alex Heart Events)[/b]" option for Alex, since by default it's not active.
These specific edits are the same ones from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33113][b]Accessible Alex Heart Events[/b] [/url]mod, which is [b]not needed[/b] for the edits to work but I'd still advise you to check out the mod page for more information about the edits made.

Also you can use Generic Mod Config Tool to turn off which characters you don't want their heart events to be played in order, just choose [b]OFF[/b] in their respective config.
This mod does [b]not[/b] change the dating/marriage mechanics, you can still date/marry any marriage candidate even when you haven't seen all their heart events, you only need the right amount of friendship points.
Also I only edited the conditions of the [b]pre-marriage heart events[/b], so you will still be able to see their 14th heart event even if you haven't seen their previous ones.

[color=#980000][size=4]WARNING[/size][/color][color=#980000][size=4]: This mod may not work with others that edit the marriage candidates vanilla heart events.[/size][/color]
You need [b]SMAPI[/b], [b]Content Patcher[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Tool[/b] for this mod to work.
